steps.what: Read the sponsor note for product, price, store and show
Choose which product facts to say and what to hold up
Copy chosen product, price, store and show onto the cue
Reject a cue price or store that is not on the note
Describe or demonstrate products viewers may purchase through specific shows or in stores

tasks.design: She still chooses the facts and still describes or demonstrates the product on the show. The work removed is copying product, price, store and show from the sponsor note onto a separate cue in {DOCS}. Reading the note itself on air is not that copy, and a save of the aired mention in the same store is not counted.
tasks.previous_blocker: The four facts sat in a paragraph, so a fixed line could not tell the price from a colour.
tasks.enabler_now: Once the sponsor note has product, price, store and show as fields, a cue can copy only those fields.
tasks.still_hard: Holding the product, and saying it so a viewer knows how to buy it.
tasks.human_edge: She can tell when a listed price would mislead a viewer of this show.
tasks.altitude: Her week still holds the choice of facts and the on-air description. Only the copy onto a separate cue leaves, and only when she makes that copy today.

reach.task: Prepare the sponsor note for a show.
reach.learn: Write product, price, store and show as separate fields.

evidence.claim: Copying product, price, store and show from a sponsor note onto a separate cue is retyping. Speaking the product on air is not that copy.
Article 50(4) says public-interest text made by AI needs a label unless a person reviews it under editorial responsibility, and synthetic audio needs disclosure.
A cue she checks and then reads in her own voice is not synthetic audio of her.
An editor was suspended because AI-invented quotes appeared in 15 of 53 blog posts.

assumptions: The focal role is the broadcast announcer. Whoever first writes the sponsor note is outside her baseline.
The cue copy needs four fields: product name, price, store, and show name. She marks them in s2. If any field is blank, the copy does not run and she reads the note.
The copy counts only when the cue is a second writing, not the sponsor note. If she reads the note on air, no time is removed.
Saving the aired mention in the same document store is not counted. A playout log that already records the spot is existing runtime, not her hours.
The 15 of 53 invented-quote rate is not her error rate. The reject step exists so a cue cannot add a price or a store.
She speaks in her own voice. This design does not generate audio.
National rules on commercial mentions vary. This design does not file a permit or score her from the cue.
unknowns: Whether this station's sponsor notes already split product, price, store and show into fields.
Whether a second person must clear commercial copy before air.
Whether the works council treats a cue template as a system that needs consent.
research_questions: How often does she retype the four fields onto a cue, versus reading the sponsor note on air?
Does the playout log already name the spot without an entry from her?

already_counted.description: Reading the note, choosing facts, rejecting a bad cue, and describing the product stay in her week.

incremental.description: She confirms the four field names when the sponsor form changes.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: A week where every sponsor note has the four fields and she still writes a separate cue is the high case. A week where she reads the note on air has no copy to remove.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: She still chooses what to say and still describes or demonstrates the product. Only the copy onto a separate cue leaves, and only when that copy happens today.
reach: A producer can mark product, price, store and show on the sponsor note so the announcer does not hunt for them in a paragraph.
skills_to_grow: Mark product, price, store and show before a cue is filled.
Reject a cue that names a price the sponsor note does not have.
role.ambitious_version: No unattended voice reads a product price on air.

job.title: Broadcast Announcers and Radio Disc Jockeys
